description: Дані про споживання комунальних ресурсів (електроенергія, теплова енергія, природний газ, тверде паливо, холодна та гаряча вода) комунальними підприємствами, установами (закладами) та організаціями is a dataset listed in data.gov.ua, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Броварська міська рада Броварського району Київської області. The set contains information on the consumption of communal resources by educational institutions of the Department of Education and Science of the Brovary City Council of the Brovary district of the Kyiv region. In particular, data on the institution, suppliers, types of services, indicators of meters, dates of their fixation. Coverage: Броварська міська рада Броварського району Київської області. The portal shows the English title as "Data on consumption of communal resources (electricity, thermal energy, natural gas, solid fuel, cold and hot water) by " (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Броварська міська рада Броварського району Київської області. Its keywords include водопостачання, споживання, газ, теплопостачання, ресурси, енергоефективність. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2026-09-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-ua.
